answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The mirror of work and the kernel of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a ferrous to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
